Here's what was built across 5 cycles: | Cycle | Test | Result | |-------|------|--------| | 1 | `SubscriberList` renders an empty list | establishes API shape | | 2 | renders each subscriber's name | drove `{name}` | | 3 | renders each subscriber's email as a mailto link | drove `` | | 4 | renders each subscriber's topics | drove `topics.join(", ")` | | 5 | wire Dashboard → SubscriberList | existing Dashboard tests proved the contract held | `Dashboard.tsx` now owns the data and passes it to `SubscriberList` — the inline markup is gone. `SubscriberList.test.tsx` owns all the rendering assertions; the Dashboard tests were never modified.
